context: A uni student coaches a teen friend through self-doubt
purpose: Teach: ひとこと/おいら/ポジティブ/多彩/過言/漠然と/心境/好感

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 最近さ、なんか漠然と将来が不安なんだよね…私って取り柄ないし。
lines.en: Lately, I just vaguely feel anxious about my future... I don't have any strengths.
lines.style: Teen voice trailing off, soft and uncertain, slightly self-deprecating tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ちょっと待った。ひとこと言わせて。
lines.en: Hold up. Let me say one thing.
lines.style: Warm older-brother energy, gentle interruption, leaning in with playful seriousness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: さくらの良いとこ、おいらが全部リストにできるくらいあるよ。
lines.en: Sakura's good points — I could literally list them all out.
lines.style: Playful confidence, light teasing reassurance, slightly goofy first-person to lighten mood.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: えー、嘘じゃん…正直、信じられないんだけど。
lines.en: What, no way... honestly, I really can't believe that.
lines.style: Skeptical teen pout, half-laughing, voice rising in disbelief.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 嘘じゃないって。絵も歌もスポーツもいけるし、多彩って言っても過言じゃない。
lines.en: I'm not lying. Art, singing, sports — calling you multi-talented isn't an overstatement.
lines.style: Steady earnest delivery, listing points firmly but casually to push back against doubt.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: そんな風に言ってくれる人、初めてかも…なんか今の心境、好感しかないんだけど、先輩。
lines.en: No one's ever said that to me before... honestly, right now I feel nothing but warmth toward you, senpai.
lines.style: Voice softening into shy laughter, gratitude leaking through teasing words.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: だろ?だからさ、もっとポジティブな顔して胸張って歩けって。下向いてる時間がもったいない。
lines.en: Right? So put on a more positive face and walk tall. Looking down just wastes time.
lines.style: Encouraging push, voice firm but kind, ending with a gentle smile.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん…なんか少しだけ、前向ける気がしてきた。ありがとう、先輩。
lines.en: Yeah... I feel like I can face forward just a little bit now. Thanks, senpai.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity, voice steadying, small genuine smile breaking through doubt.
